userManualRuntimeObservation.observedFramerate: Approximately 144 FPS smooth rendering on user machine
userManualRuntimeObservation.observationType: Manual runtime observation (not an automated benchmark or instrumented measurement)
userManualRuntimeObservation.hardwareOrDisplayNote: Reported on user 144 Hz display; no unrecorded hardware or test conditions inferred
userManualRuntimeObservation.evaluationConclusion: Optimized Candidate B delivers sufficiently good observed runtime performance for Milestone 2.1; runtime performance is no longer considered a blocker for M2.1.

profilingCaveats.hoverRaycastScope: hoverRaycastTimeMs measures resolveInspectedFeature() feature-info resolution time once an intersection occurs, not the complete R3F/Three.js scene-wide CPU raycasting traversal.
profilingCaveats.nodeInspectionTimingScope: The 4.03 ms inspection timing is a Node-side raycast against the isolated railway group (evaluateFrustumAndRaycastAtPose), not the full browser R3F scene raycast.
profilingCaveats.scenarioTimingCaveat: Timings derived from requestAnimationFrame followed by setTimeout are not reliable frame-time measurements (particularly on 144 Hz displays). Automated browser timers must not be presented as proof of actual browser frame interval.
profilingCaveats.softwareRasterizerNote: Headless Chromium in container environments uses Google SwiftShader (CPU Software WebGL2 rasterizer). Software rasterizer timings are strictly for headless sanity checking and never used to rank candidate performance.

deferredNonRailwayFindings.issue: Non-railway building draw-call amplification from BufferGeometry.groups
deferredNonRailwayFindings.description: In Configuration A (zero railways), the scene issues 2,537 WebGL draw calls per frame (2,480 gl.drawArrays) despite having only 57 THREE.Mesh objects. This is caused by THREE.ExtrudeGeometry creating 2 groups per building (613 x 2 = 1,226 groups), which mergeWithFaceRanges() in GeometryBuilder.ts preserves onto the merged building meshes. WebGLRenderer renders each group as a separate draw call in both the directional shadow pass and the camera pass (1,226 x 2 = 2,452 calls).
deferredNonRailwayFindings.disposition: Documented as a known, deferred rendering-optimization finding for future work; not part of M2.1 scope.

browserLiveTelemetry.gpuTimerQueryImplementation: Bracketed rawGl.beginQuery(TIME_ELAPSED_EXT) / rawGl.endQuery(TIME_ELAPSED_EXT) around gl.render(scene, camera) in MapScene.tsx with async FIFO polling and GPU_DISJOINT_EXT invalidation.
